_comment: R32: one single-edit mutant per invariant the exported conformance suite claims. `pnpm test:mutants` applies each to a temporary copy and requires it to fail at least one case of runConsoleServicesConformance or runMutationSafetyConformance. A surviving mutant means the suite states an invariant it cannot enforce, which is the defect this list exists to prevent. Ids are this repository's; where a mutant reproduces a survivor from the round-4 review, `was` records the reviewer's id.
